body_long:
The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection has appointed Alan J. Leibman as its chief executive officer. The company announced the appointment on 10 November 2026. He also joins its board of directors and succeeds Ernesto Fara. In the same announcement, Tatiana Ferreira, until now Chief Sales Officer, becomes President.

## Back where it started

Alan Leibman's hospitality career began in 1990 at The Ritz-Carlton in Houston. According to the company, he became the youngest general manager in The Ritz-Carlton's history, at 25. He later served as CEO of Kerzner International, the group behind the Atlantis and One&Only resorts, overseeing a portfolio across five continents. More recently he advised hospitality and travel companies across Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and was a senior adviser to the investment firm Oaktree. He brings more than three decades of experience in global luxury hospitality.

His own words on the move are simple: "The Ritz-Carlton has been an important part of my career since the beginning."

## A new President

Tatiana Ferreira keeps responsibility for sales and commercial strategy, and now adds IT, marketing and guest experience. She has nearly 25 years of experience with companies including Louis Vuitton, Neiman Marcus, Starwood Hotels & Resorts and The Walt Disney Company.

Executive Chairman Jim Murren and Marriott International CEO Anthony Capuano both welcomed the appointments.

## The fleet

The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection sails three yachts. Evrima, the first, launched in October 2022 with 149 suites. Ilma followed in September 2024, and Luminara set sail in July 2025. Itineraries include the Mediterranean and Northern Europe.

## The signal

Luxury at sea is now run like a hotel brand. By choosing a leader who started as a Ritz-Carlton general manager and later ran One&Only, the company puts hotel service culture at the helm of its yachts, at a time when Aman, Four Seasons and others are also taking their names to sea.

Congratulations to Alan Leibman and Tatiana Ferreira on their new roles.
